newsitem.title: USA: Exile in double trouble after Cuba trip.
newsitem.headline: Exile in double trouble after Cuba trip.

text.p: When Mario Moreno got home after spending five months in a Cuban jail for a failed attempt to bring his daughter from Havana, U.S. authorities charged him with grand theft for failing to return a rented boat on time.

Moreno pleaded guilty on Monday in a Broward County court to a reduced charge of petty theft and was fined $100. He rented the boat from a Fort Lauderdale marina in January 1994 to sail to Cuba to pick up his daughter Joanna and was supposed to return it by sundown the same day.

But Moreno, 53, who came from Cuba to Miami in 1981, was arrested by Cuban authorities and jailed. Five months later he was freed and sent home in the boat, which had been stripped. The U.S. Coast Guard picked him up off Key West.
